desc: Mossy Oak Bottomland finish. SoftFlex™ Cheek Pad increases shooting comfort. Oversize bolt release and bolt handle. Composite stock can be trimmed and is shim adjustable for cast, drop and length of pull. Rubber overmolding on stock and forearm add grip in all conditions. Trigger guard is ramped for easier loading. Screw-on magazine cap. Nickel Teflon™ Coating on the bolt, bolt slide, shell carrier, bolt release and bolt handle protect and add lubricity. Lightweight magazine tube reduces weight. Chrome chamber and bore increase durability and corrosion resistance. Drilled and tapped receiver for an optics base. Fiber-optic front sight and ivory mid-bead. ABS hard case included. Extended X-Full Turkey choke tube plus three extended Invector-Plus choke tubes included (F, M, IC). Ideal for hunting/turkey
